note: SPEC M5 hard gates, generic (any subject). Values marked assumed until E-D calibrates them; a subject may override a gate only with the user's OK.

gate_notes.region_iou_min: M5: per-region IoU on observed pixels (and the whole horse)
gate_notes.landmark_max: M5: each landmark, fraction of body length; also the key-detail search radius
gate_notes.coverage_iou_min: M5: per label class IoU on observed pixels, classes with at least coverage_min_share of them
gate_notes.delta_e_max: M5: CIEDE2000 (kL = 2, textile weighting) between region-core means, exposure-compensated
gate_notes.detail_ncc_min: assumed (E-D 2D): gradient-magnitude NCC of each key detail's patch, found within landmark_max
gate_notes.plate_period_tol: assumed (E-D 2D): plate period by FFT within this fraction of the reference's (E-B's measure, made a gate so plate size can fail)
gate_notes.region_min_px: regions and colour classes with fewer observed pixels are not scored
gate_notes.hue_max_deg: assumed (E-D 2D): hue angle difference of region means, classes with reference chroma >= 15
gate_notes.label_scale: not a gate: labels are compared as the majority class within this fraction of body length, and region / coverage IoU count a pixel matched when the other map has it within the same distance (E-D 2D v001, v003)
